# Not measured, with the reason; the tables keep their documented spelling for these:
#   COPILOT ENCODEURL FILTERXML WEBSERVICE: unknown to Excel on the measuring host (stored as typed, cached #NAME?)
# JIS is the ja-JP formula-bar spelling of DBCS; Excel stores the call as DBCS.
# ANCHORARRAY is not typed by name; Excel stores it for the spill reference operator.
